ai.gk: IIT Madras was established in 1959 in Chennai. IIT stands for Indian Institute of Technology. AI, or Artificial Intelligence, is the ability of computer systems to perform tasks that normally need human intelligence.

quiz.explain: The AI Fundamentals cohort starts on 23 November 2026; 14 November is the Space Science course.
quiz.q: On which date does the free AI Fundamentals course for school students begin?

ai.summary: IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies Foundation, with BodhBridge Education, announced the programme on 11 November for cohorts running from November 2026 to January 2027. The AI Fundamentals course starts on 23 November; other courses cover space science, entrepreneurship, electric vehicles, financial literacy and design thinking. Registration for the live classes is free, teachers get separate courses from January 2027, and a certificate is optional through a proctored online exam.
ai.title: IIT Madras Pravartak opens free live online courses, including AI Fundamentals, for students of Classes 7 to 12.

ai.gk: SWAYAM stands for Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds, the Government of India's online course platform launched in 2017. Amaravati is the capital of Andhra Pradesh. ITI stands for Industrial Training Institute.

quiz.explain: The target is 50 lakh, the state's share of the Centre's goal of one crore AI-skilled people.
quiz.q: How many students and young people does Andhra Pradesh plan to train in AI skills?

ai.summary: The state Education Department's plan covers 14 lakh students of Classes 8 to 10, 10 lakh higher-education students, 6.5 lakh Intermediate students, 3.5 lakh polytechnic and ITI students and 16 lakh unemployed youth and others. Teachers are to be trained first, courses will run through SWAYAM Plus, and completed AI courses will be credited on mark sheets. The report notes that one in three Indian schools still has no working computer, a gap that such plans must close.
ai.title: Andhra Pradesh plans to give AI skills to 50 lakh students and young people.
CBSE's National Teachers' Conference on Computational Thinking and AI is set for 20-21 November in Pune.
ai.summary: CBSE will hold its National Teachers' Conference 2026 in Pune on 20 and 21 November, on the theme of computational thinking and understanding artificial intelligence. Teachers, principals, counsellors and special educators of CBSE-affiliated schools take part as delegates or paper presenters. The seven sub-themes include AI readiness, mathematics and AI, pedagogy and assessment, and responsible use of AI.
ai.gk: Computational thinking means solving problems step by step in a way a computer could carry out: breaking a problem into parts, spotting patterns and writing clear instructions. CBSE is headquartered in New Delhi.
ai.exam: For teachers: CBSE's direction on computational thinking and AI in classrooms. For teaching exams and interviews: know the terms computational thinking, AI readiness and responsible AI.

quiz.q: In which city is CBSE's National Teachers' Conference 2026 on computational thinking and AI being held?
quiz.explain: The conference is scheduled for 20-21 November 2026 in Pune.

ai.title: Google's free AI Educator Series is expanding to more countries; 80,000 Indian educators were trained in September.
ai.summary: In a 3 November 2026 post, Google said its no-cost, on-demand AI training for educators now runs in India, Korea, Malaysia, the Philippines and the UK and Ireland, with Brazil, Mexico, Spain, Australia and sub-Saharan Africa to follow. In India, September sessions trained 80,000 educators, and self-paced modules are available in English and six Indian languages.
ai.gk: The National Education Policy 2020 calls for integrating technology in teaching and for continuous professional development of teachers.
ai.exam: For teachers: a free professional-development option. For exams: NEP 2020 provisions on technology in education and teacher training.

quiz.q: Google's AI Educator Series is training meant mainly for whom?
quiz.explain: It is a no-cost AI skills training for educators.

headlines.gk: CPI stands for Consumer Price Index. The Reserve Bank of India, set up in 1935 and headquartered in Mumbai, has an inflation target of 4% with a tolerance band of 2% to 6%.
headlines.summary: Data released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation on 12 November show CPI inflation at 6.09% in October, up from 5.54% in September and the highest since October 2024. Food inflation rose to 8.94%, with onion prices up 116.22% over a year ago. The RBI's next Monetary Policy Committee meeting is on 2-4 December.
headlines.title: Retail inflation rises to 6.09% in October, a 24-month high and above the RBI's 6% upper limit.

headlines.gk: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product, the total value of goods and services produced in a country. Moody's, S&P and Fitch are known as the 'Big Three' credit rating agencies. India's financial year runs from 1 April to 31 March.
headlines.summary: In its Global Macro Outlook 2027-28, Moody's cited strong domestic consumption, improving investment and India's resilience to higher global energy prices. It expects growth to stay near 7% over the medium term. The agency flagged rising inflation, weaker farm output and higher interest rates as risks.
headlines.title: Moody's Ratings raises India's growth forecast for the current financial year to 7% from 6.5%.

headlines.gk: ASEAN is the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, founded on 8 August 1967 in Bangkok; its secretariat is in Jakarta and it now has 11 members. Manila is the capital of the Philippines. India's Look East Policy was upgraded to the Act East Policy in 2014.
headlines.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs said the Prime Minister will take part in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit, held alongside the 49th ASEAN Summit in the Philippines. MEA Secretary (East) Rupendra Tandon called ASEAN a key building block of India's Act East Policy. The summit theme is 'Navigating the Future'.
headlines.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will attend the ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits in Manila from 16 to 18 November.

headlines.gk: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago nation and the most populous Muslim-majority country. Its currency is the rupiah, and it is a founding member of ASEAN.
headlines.summary: Gibran, 39, the eldest son of former President Joko Widodo, submitted his resignation to President Prabowo Subianto and parliament on 12 November. Indonesia's top courts ruled last month that his overseas education documents did not meet election requirements. The People's Consultative Assembly must now elect a replacement from two candidates named by the President within 60 days.
headlines.title: Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigns two years into his five-year term.

headlines.gk: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates. Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine and Moscow of Russia. The treatment of prisoners of war is governed by the Third Geneva Convention of 1949.
headlines.summary: The agreement came after two days of talks, but there was no breakthrough on ending the nearly five-year war. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner called the talks difficult but productive, with final numbers still to come. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the step and said European countries must be part of security negotiations.
headlines.title: Russia and Ukraine agree in principle on a major prisoner-of-war exchange after US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

headlines.gk: Tuberculosis is caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, identified by Robert Koch in 1882. World TB Day is observed on 24 March. The WHO (World Health Organization) was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Geneva.
headlines.summary: The report, released on 12 November, puts India's fall in TB mortality at 38% since 2015 against a global decline of 35%. The treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB is 94%. Under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, over 25 crore people were screened between 7 December 2024 and 8 November 2026 and 48.64 lakh new cases were found.
headlines.title: India's tuberculosis deaths are down 38% since 2015, says a government release citing the WHO Global TB Report 2026.

headlines.gk: The Blue Flag is an eco-label for clean and safe beaches awarded by the Denmark-based Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE). India's first Blue Flag beaches were certified in 2020. Maharashtra's coastal strip is called the Konkan.
headlines.summary: Ladghar and Guhagar beaches in Ratnagiri district and Shrivardhan beach in Raigad district received the Blue Flag for the 2026-27 season. They met standards on cleanliness, water quality, biodiversity protection and tourist safety. The Blue Flag season at the three beaches begins on 15 November.
headlines.title: Three Konkan beaches win the international Blue Flag award, a first for Maharashtra.
CBSE asks schools to nominate student innovators for the National Startup Awards 2026.
headlines.summary: In a circular to its affiliated schools, CBSE has asked them to identify and nominate students for the sixth edition of the National Startup Awards. Students aged 10 and above can enter the Student Innovator / Aspiring Entrepreneur category, and the four student innovation categories carry a prize pool of Rs 25 lakh. The awards are run by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
headlines.gk: DPIIT works under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The Startup India initiative was launched on 16 January 2016, and 16 January is observed as National Startup Day.
The Asia Cup tournaments are organised by the Asian Cricket Council (ACC), formed in 1983. Muscat is the capital of Oman. A One Day International innings lasts a maximum of 50 overs.
headlines.summary: In the semi-final at Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Oman on 12 November, India chased a target of 228, reaching 230 for 2 in 36.5 overs. Captain Lakshya Raichandani scored 93 off 90 balls and VK Vineeth made 57 not out. Pakistan beat Bangladesh by 9 wickets in the other semi-final.
headlines.title: India beat Afghanistan by 8 wickets to reach the Under-19 Asia Cup final against Pakistan.

headlines.gk: SAFF is the South Asian Football Federation, founded in 1997. The AIFF (All India Football Federation) was founded in 1937. Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh and Thimphu the capital of Bhutan.
headlines.summary: Suhail Ahmad Bhat's 38th-minute penalty gave India a 1-0 win over the Maldives at the National Stadium in Dhaka on 11 November. India finished Group B with 6 points, ahead of Pakistan on 3, after earlier beating Pakistan 3-2. Bhat now has three goals in the tournament.
headlines.title: India top their group at the SAFF Championship and will play Bhutan in the semi-final on 14 November.
Unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July-September 2026, shows the PLFS quarterly bulletin.
headlines.summary: The Periodic Labour Force Survey bulletin for July-September 2026 puts unemployment among people aged 15 and above at 5.1%, down from 5.4% in the previous quarter. The Labour Force Participation Rate rose to 55.5% and the Worker Population Ratio to 52.7%.
headlines.gk: The PLFS is conducted by the National Statistics Office under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI). It was launched in 2017.
headlines.exam: Economy and data questions in UPSC, SSC and banking exams. Remember the three terms: LFPR (people working or seeking work), WPR (people actually employed) and UR (unemployed as a share of the labour force).

headlines.title: RBI issues cybersecurity directions for non-bank payment system operators.
headlines.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued cyber resilience directions for non-bank payment system operators under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. They apply to large and medium operators from 5 November 2026, and small operators have until 1 April 2028. Incidents such as cyberattacks and critical outages must be reported to the RBI and CERT-In within six hours.
headlines.gk: The RBI was established on 1 April 1935 and is headquartered in Mumbai. CERT-In is India's national agency for cyber incident response and works under the Ministry of Electronics and IT.
headlines.exam: Banking awareness for IBPS, SBI and RBI exams: note the Act (PSS Act, 2007), the six-hour reporting rule and the two agencies to be informed.

headlines.title: IRDAI forms two working groups to move insurers to a risk-based capital framework.
headlines.summary: On 10 November 2026 the insurance regulator IRDAI set up two working groups, one for life and one for non-life insurers, to shift the sector from a factor-based solvency regime to a risk-based capital (RBC) framework aligned with Ind AS accounting standards.
headlines.gk: IRDAI is the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, set up under the IRDA Act, 1999, with its head office in Hyderabad.
headlines.exam: Insurance and banking exams (LIC AAO, NIACL, IBPS): know what IRDAI is, where it is based, and that risk-based capital links the capital an insurer must hold to the risks it carries.

headlines.title: Patna Municipal Corporation lists Bihar's first municipal bond on the NSE, raising about Rs 200 crore.
headlines.summary: Patna Municipal Corporation has become the first urban local body in Bihar to raise money through municipal bonds listed on the National Stock Exchange. It raised about Rs 199.99 crore at a 9.20% annual coupon for 10 years. The money will fund 18 projects, including vending zones, parking and a commercial complex.
headlines.gk: A municipal bond is a debt security issued by a city body to fund local infrastructure. In India these issues are regulated by SEBI.
headlines.exam: Economy, polity and state PSC questions: municipal bonds as a source of urban local body finance, and 'first in the state' facts for Bihar exams.

headlines.title: India and Saudi Arabia sign the Bilateral Haj Agreement for 2027; quota stays at 1,75,025.
headlines.summary: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju visited Saudi Arabia from 6 to 9 November 2026, and the two countries signed the Bilateral Haj Agreement-2027 in Jeddah. India's pilgrim quota is 1,75,025, unchanged since 2025.
headlines.gk: Haj affairs in India are handled by the Ministry of Minority Affairs. The Haj Committee of India is a statutory body under the Haj Committee Act, 2002.
headlines.exam: International relations and 'agreements signed' questions: remember the place (Jeddah), the minister and the quota figure.

headlines.title: Delhi gets its first Yamuna river cruise, on National Waterway-110.
headlines.summary: On 10 November 2026, Union Ports, Shipping and Waterways Minister Sarbananda Sonowal inaugurated Delhi's first Yamuna cruise at Sonia Vihar. A 30-seat electric vessel runs on the Sonia Vihar-Jagatpur stretch, about 6 km for the round trip. The Inland Waterways Authority of India leads the project.
headlines.gk: The National Waterways Act, 2016 declared 111 national waterways. The Yamuna is NW-110, and NW-1 is the Ganga from Prayagraj to Haldia. The Inland Waterways Authority of India was set up in 1986 and is headquartered in Noida.
headlines.exam: Geography and infrastructure questions in UPSC and SSC: national waterway numbers, the 2016 Act and the IWAI.

headlines.title: British author M. John Harrison wins the 2026 Booker Prize for 'The End of Everything'.
headlines.summary: M. John Harrison won the 2026 Booker Prize on 9 November in London for his novel 'The End of Everything'. At 81 he is the oldest winner of the prize, and the first writer known mainly for science fiction to win it. The prize carries GBP 50,000.
headlines.gk: The Booker Prize was first awarded in 1969 for fiction written in English and published in the UK or Ireland. The separate International Booker Prize is for books translated into English. Indian winners include Arundhati Roy (1997), Kiran Desai (2006) and Aravind Adiga (2008).
headlines.exam: Awards and honours is a fixed section in almost every competitive exam: remember the winner, the book, the prize money and the difference between the Booker and the International Booker.

headlines.title: ISRO completes a 200-second test of the cryogenic engine for the GSLV-F19 mission.
headlines.summary: ISRO has completed a 200-second flight acceptance test of a cryogenic engine at the ISRO Propulsion Complex in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu. The engine will power the cryogenic stage of GSLV-F19, which is to launch the navigation satellite NVS-04 in 2027.
headlines.gk: NavIC stands for Navigation with Indian Constellation, India's own regional satellite navigation system. A cryogenic engine burns liquid hydrogen with liquid oxygen at very low temperatures.
headlines.exam: Science and technology questions: the rocket (GSLV), the satellite series (NVS, for NavIC), the test site (Mahendragiri) and how a cryogenic engine works.

headlines.title: MSME Ministry releases Rs 1,000 crore margin money subsidy under PMEGP for 11,333 new micro enterprises.
headlines.summary: Union MSME Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi released Rs 1,000 crore as margin money subsidy under the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP), supporting 11,333 new micro enterprises.
headlines.gk: PMEGP was launched in 2008 as a credit-linked subsidy scheme of the Ministry of MSME. The Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) is its national-level implementing agency.
headlines.exam: Government schemes are asked in every exam: note the launch year, the ministry, the implementing agency and that PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for self-employment.

headlines.title: Sitar maestro and Padma Shri awardee Pandit Manilal Nag dies at 87.
headlines.summary: Pandit Manilal Nag, a sitar maestro of the Bishnupur Gharana, died in Kolkata on 9 November 2026 aged 87. He was born in Bankura, West Bengal, in 1939. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2001 and the Padma Shri in 2020.
headlines.gk: The Bishnupur Gharana of Hindustani classical music comes from Bishnupur in West Bengal's Bankura district. The Padma Shri is India's fourth-highest civilian award.
headlines.exam: Art and culture, and 'personalities in news' questions: link the artist to the instrument (sitar), the gharana (Bishnupur) and the awards.
